subject: Fix D3D12 noise screenshots on long runs
description: Tour shots 5-6 on snapshot 11's D3D12 exe and the renderer agent's HEAD tour stop 8 came out as full-screen noise, with no errors in the logs. The D3D12 agent (aeb175efafb6a6358) is root-causing it: is the frame or only the readback corrupt, and are allocations failing unchecked under memory pressure? Land the fix through the snapshot pipeline, then rerun the Scorecard 4 tour.
